rationale: Literal Vantage Manual is recorded under Vantage (42815, MY2020) and Vantage Manual (43215, MY2021). Merge these source bases and their observed variants conservatively; no generation-independence assertion.

Literal RS 3 bridges RS 3 and RS (38966 versus 41423/46638); literal RS 5 bridges RS 5 and RS (39538 versus 42772). Keep the connected source component together, including its observed Cabriolet/Sportback variants. RS is already a broad source label; this does not assert that RS 3 and RS 5 are one physical vehicle family.

Literal TT Coupe quattro bridges TT Coupe and TT (34664 versus 43326); literal TT Roadster quattro bridges TT Roadster and TT (36380/39031 versus 44097). Approve the transitive connected source component to avoid splitting these unchanged full names across source-base aliases.

Literal TTS Coupe is recorded under TTS Coupe (41201) and TTS (41988/43487). Keep all observed variants assigned to either source base in one group. The rule uses exact normalized full names, not a TTS prefix guess.

Literal Continental GT Convertible is recorded under both Continental GT Convertible and Continental, including 41980 and 42407 in MY2020. Retain the full connected source-base component, including source-assigned GT/GTC/Speed variants; no common-generation claim.

Literal M850i xDrive Convertible is recorded under M (43147, MY2021) and 8 Series (43805, MY2022). Approve the conservative source component. M is a broad existing label containing M2/M3/M4/M5/M6/M8 and other observed names; canonical 8 series is only a deterministic grouping identifier and does not reclassify those products as physical 8 Series vehicles.

Literal 500 L is recorded under 500 L (e.g. 35306 and 39066) and 500 (40419/41650). Keep these bases together with all observed variants. Source 500 already contains 500/500 Abarth/500X AWD labels; no platform-equivalence assertion.

Literal RC F is recorded under RC F (37136) and RC (39815/40184/41453/46350/47322). Merge the source-base aliases and retain all observed RC 300/350/F variants in the same source component; no prefix heuristic is used.

Literal JCW Countryman All4 is recorded under Countryman (36670/36671) and John Cooper Works (40025/40058/46502/47800). Keep the entire connected source component, including source-assigned Convertible/Hardtop/Clubman/Coupe names. John Cooper Works is already broad; this conservative grouping does not assert one physical product or generation.

Literal Rogue Sport AWD is recorded under Rogue (38649, MY2017) and Rogue Sport (42337, MY2020). Merge the source-base aliases and retain all observed variants. This is conservative catalogue grouping and does not assert identical Rogue and Rogue Sport platforms.

Literal Stage 3 Mustang is recorded under Mustang (e.g. 36835/41002) and Stage 3 Mustang (42318/42386). Merge both source bases and their observed Mustang/Stage 3 Mustang variants without fuzzy or prefix matching.

Literal Impreza 4-Door, Impreza 5-Door and Impreza Sport 5-Door each occur under Impreza/Outback Sport and Impreza (e.g. 38329 versus 38876, 38345 versus 38890, 38346 versus 40207). Approve one conservative component containing all source-assigned variants; generations are not independently certified.

Literal Legacy AWD connects Legacy/Outback with Legacy (36406 versus 40373); literal Outback AWD connects Legacy/Outback with Outback (36434 versus 38856). Approve the transitive component and both full-name variants. Shared source taxonomy supports conservative grouping, not a claim that Legacy and Outback generations are independent or identical.
